content: Fetches as CSV, from USGS's FDSN event service, the hypocentres (latitude, longitude, depth, magnitude) of M4 and above around Tohoku and the Japan Trench (34–42°N, 138–146°E) for 2000–2024, and passes them on as a folder.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The result of fetching the earthquake catalogue
